findings.claim: The Surreal projection snapshot code references a non-existent EntityRow field, so the workspace will not compile.
findings.evidence: In `crates/frf-projection-surreal/src/model.rs`, `EntityRow` fields are `entity_id`, `tenant_id`, `op`, `data_json`, `previous_json`, `timestamp`, `version`, and `typed_delivery_json`; the new `snapshot_entity_type` implementation in `crates/frf-projection-surreal/src/store.rs` checks `row.entity_type != entity_type.canonical_name()`, but `entity_type` is not a field on `EntityRow`. This violates R1 (`cargo check --workspace` is clean).
findings.suggested_fix: Either add and populate an `entity_type` field on `EntityRow`, or remove the row-level `row.entity_type` check and filter using the parsed `typed_delivery().mutation` fields after confirming the row tenant.
